reply.summary: Siamvau is a vain schemer who dresses every robbery up as a puzzle and gloats when pursuers fail to solve it. He relies on clever traps, a long walking staff and a mind that no one can read. Careful planning is his craft, not brute force.

feats.scene: Siamvau cracks his staff across a vault door hinge until the bolt shears off.
Siamvau drops through a skylight onto a concrete floor and strolls away without a limp.

reply.summary: Taole is a frail, forgetful old crook whose mind has drifted far from his glory days. He still shuffles out of the ward to rob banks on holidays, never noticing that the vaults stand empty.

feats.scene: Taole swings a rolled newspaper at a bank clerk and knocks his glasses askew.
Taole tumbles down a flight of stairs outside the hospital and complains only about his hat.

reply.summary: Ritorcor is a sharp-minded schemer who turns up only as a rumour at first, then as a gunman inside a dreamed-up false world. He carries a stolen lucky coin and trusts cunning over muscle.

feats.scene: Ritorcor fires a pistol at a young costumed fighter across a rooftop and drops him with one round.
Ritorcor takes a heavy blow from a masked avenger and is left unconscious but alive.

reply.summary: Iumenu is a corrupt detective struck by lightning during a particle blast, which turned him into a channel for a boundless speed field. He grew into a tyrant who rules by terror, though his racing body burns through food at a ruinous rate.

feats.scene: Iumenu streaks across the downtown grid and arrives before the thunder from his lightning strike fades.
Iumenu vibrates a fist through a parked armoured van, leaving a smoking tunnel.
Iumenu skids across a highway at top pace and rises with scorched clothes only.

reply.summary: Nauorecor was once a loyal apprentice to a monster slayer, until a cult of bloodsuckers turned him into one of the creatures he hunted and fed him a lie about who was to blame. Decades of hate drove him to take his old master prisoner, and shame finished him when the truth came out.

feats.scene: Nauorecor hurls a grown man through a wooden door and into the far wall of the cellar.
Nauorecor stands unharmed after a fall from a bell tower, shrugging off every broken bone.

reply.summary: Liatelam was a pupil at a school for aspiring wrongdoers, nimble and quick on the bars but outmatched in a real fight. When two classmates switched sides, his short criminal career ended in handcuffs.

feats.scene: Liatelam springs off a wall and plants both feet in a guard's chest.
Liatelam lands badly from a vault and walks off the mat.

reply.summary: Soriarum is a polished tycoon whose public smile hides a ruthless underworld empire. He built his fortune by cheating a partner, then moulded a bright protege only to ruin him when loyalty wavered.

feats.scene: Soriarum slaps a rival's phone from his hand across a boardroom table.
Soriarum is thrown against a glass wall by an angry employee and straightens his tie.

reply.summary: Veoone is a teenage hacker in a suit lined with vials of gas that grant different gifts at will, which he uses to wreck his father's company and win a glance of approval. A bad overdose once turned him to solid rock until scientists reversed it.

feats.scene: Veoone dials up a heat-blast vial and burns a hole through a loading dock wall.
Veoone takes a full volley from a squad of armed guards while his skin turns hard as stone.

reply.summary: Ralinas is a boy ghost who died long ago at school and now solves supernatural cases alongside a friend who chose to stay with him instead of moving on. He is polite, curious, and quietly searching for a romance he cannot quite feel.

feats.scene: Ralinas slams a haunted wardrobe shut with a burst of cold spectral force.
Ralinas lets a swinging iron gate pass straight through his chest without harm.

reply.summary: Ciltel is a small-time thief turned lawman whose body was altered by strange chemicals after a botched job, letting him twist into any shape. Bullets bounce off his stretchy frame, and even clean cuts knit together quickly.

feats.scene: Ciltel extends an arm thirty metres down a corridor and flattens a gunman with a single smack.
Ciltel stretches around a burst of machine-gun fire and snaps back unmarked.

reply.summary: Stucor is a retired crime-fighter who once fell into a vat of acid and gained a stretchy body. Now old, he passes his gift to his son, and stretching too far makes his back ache.

feats.scene: Stucor winds a stretched arm like a spring and pops a safe door off its hinges.
Stucor absorbs a thrown crate on his elastic shoulder and bounces it back.

reply.summary: Ceoal is a sea monarch who lost her undersea kingdom to a rival queen and fled ashore to plot a counterstrike. She killed traitors, gathered stolen recipes, and in the end rallied an army to retake the throne.

feats.scene: Ceoal drives a spear through a traitor's shield in a dockside alley.
Ceoal takes a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps hunting her quarry through the night.

reply.summary: Caiumta is a bald, balding spellcaster who rules a small kingdom of his own and sets his hexes against two famous heroes. His power comes from unspecified magic, wielded with more spite than skill.

feats.scene: Caiumta calls down a green storm that levels a watchtower on the border of his domain.
Caiumta weathers a hail of arrows that turn to ash against his warding spell.

reply.summary: Ontarti is a cartoon fowl who lives in a world of talking animals and attends lessons with his classmates. He is so gullible that nearly any trick works on him.

feats.scene: Ontarti flaps a wing and knocks a schoolbook off a desk.
Ontarti is flattened by a falling anvil and pops back into shape with a squawk.

reply.summary: Loriuial is a shy, timid scholar who built a glass helmet to concentrate lunar glow into his brain. Now every full night his head blazes like a lantern and he is overwhelmed by an urge to steal, then wakes up full of regret.

feats.scene: Loriuial releases a pulse of pale light that bursts a row of streetlamps.
Loriuial is knocked flat by a bat-wielding guard and rises with his glow undimmed.

reply.summary: Terstarn is a tall, bald mastermind who builds every scheme around his love of oval shells and puns to match. He once grabbed a city's lease and banished its guardians, only to lose it to a legal loophole.

feats.scene: Terstarn heaves a stone urn at an approaching henchman who refused to laugh at the pun.
Terstarn tumbles from a rooftop awning and brushes off the dust.

reply.summary: Santean is a short military officer who seized power in a small desert state and kept up its loud hostility toward a faraway superpower. He survived an assassination plot dressed up as a rescue mission.

feats.scene: Santean backhands a captured reporter hard enough to split his lip.
Santean is shoved into a marble pillar during a palace scuffle and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Ansase is a man who was kept from true death, glimpsed an empty beyond, and now preaches that nothing waits there. He hunts those who shorten other lives, joins a revolutionary band hoping for a way to finally rest, and endures even when others think him dead.

feats.scene: Ansase hurls a burning chapel bell across a valley and shatters a stone bridge.
Ansase stands in the heart of a collapsing tower and walks out of the rubble untouched.

reply.summary: Amriaaul is a card-themed hired hand in a costumed band of thieves, doing as he is told under a commanding boss. His part in the story is a brawl against a pack of masked rogues for the price on their heads.

feats.scene: Amriaaul swings a gun butt at a masked rogue's jaw.
Amriaaul is thrown across a casino floor and gets back up.

reply.summary: Rerila is a blond thief who wears a playing-card motif and fights as part of a costumed gang. She appears briefly, a minor figure in a band that stays together by habit more than loyalty.

feats.scene: Rerila lashes out with a card-edged baton and drives a guard back.
Rerila takes a tumble over a balcony rail and lands on her feet.

reply.summary: Eretia is the heir of a powerful clan of racketeers who secretly dons a sleek cat costume to undo her late father's worst deals. She is a gifted acrobat and fighter, with claws and a whip, and finds an uneasy ally in the former thief she once spied on.

feats.scene: Eretia whips a pistol from a gangster's grip and kicks him through a screen door.
Eretia hits a wall from a rooftop leap and rolls clear without a sound.

reply.summary: Anunt is a bald, blue-eyed killer-for-hire who walks in shadow beside her brother, serving a dark house in a city of crystal. She favours blades and silence, and her career is brief.

feats.scene: Anunt throws a curved knife the length of a courtyard and pins a guard's cloak to a post.
Anunt crashes through a lattice window and rolls up unhurt.

reply.summary: Esisa is a deity of calm who is bound to a war-bringing counterpart and spreads serenity as he spreads strife. When the balance breaks she is driven mad, and she can fly, grow large, vanish and reappear, and release bolts of power.

feats.scene: Esisa casts a ring of white light that flattens a mountain plateau and everything on it.
Esisa stands at the centre of a divine duel's shockwave and her robe barely stirs.

reply.summary: Neseoern is a soldier granted a hero's gifts by his homeworld's leaders, who built him as a counter to a distant champion. Discovering he was a copy and a safeguard, he turned bitter and lashed out at those who made him.

feats.scene: Neseoern punches a crater into a mountain range and the shock rolls out across the plain.
Neseoern walks through a bombardment from an orbiting fleet with no wound.
Neseoern crosses a continent in the span of a breath.

reply.summary: Numauliu is a grey-haired mastermind who hides his lair behind a fake shop and designs lethal contraptions for fun. His ultimate trap was meant to be tested by a famous hero, who instead escaped and ended his career.

feats.scene: Numauliu triggers a counterweighted blade rig that cuts a steel beam in half.
Numauliu is knocked off his feet in a scuffle with two crime-fighters and cannot rise.

reply.summary: Teamo is a bald, blue-eyed killer-for-hire who walks in shadow beside his sister, serving a dark house in a city of crystal. He prefers blades and silence, and his career is brief.

feats.scene: Teamo drives a short sword through a wooden shield from three paces.
Teamo drops from a high wall onto stone and slips away unhurt.

reply.summary: Liune is the aging head of a gang in a big city who is tricked by a scheming woman into taking a potion that gives him a raven's traits. He gains wings and great strength, then turns on the very organisation he led.

feats.scene: Liune wrenches a car door off its frame mid-flight and tosses it over a rail.
Liune takes a long fall from a tower window and flaps upright at the bottom.

reply.summary: Sestnen is a colossal green drifter who sails the void between stars and needs no food or rest. One of his eyes was torn away and became a weapon that others have wielded for conquest.

feats.scene: Sestnen opens a gaze of green fire and cuts a barren world's crust in two.
Sestnen drifts through a dying star's flare without losing a single scale.

reply.summary: Iusia is a green-skinned, red-eyed wanderer who knows the secrets of many worlds and claims to be nobody at all. He guides a hero with riddles and visions, carries a staff, and can fly on wings, peer ahead in time and read minds.

feats.scene: Iusia points his staff and a beam of light flattens a ring of stone pillars.
Iusia stands calm while a fortress wall crashes down around him.

reply.summary: Llcoont is a stage conjurer and tinkerer who pursues wrongdoers with spells and strange gadgets in the early years of a great war. He can send out a ghostly double, move objects with thought, and stretch ropes with a spoken word.

feats.scene: Llcoont lifts a delivery truck with a wave of his hand and sets it on a rooftop.
Llcoont is thrown by a kidnapper and catches his fall with a floating ring of rope.

reply.summary: Numcillan is a prisoner of a tiny shrunken city who breaks out and swaps places with a young reporter, then gains great power under the glare of a golden sun. He sets out to kill the planet's champion and is soon returned to a cell.

feats.scene: Numcillan hurls a tanker against a cliff and brings down half the hillside.
Numcillan laughs off a tank battalion's barrage on an open field.

reply.summary: Eruser is a bandit chief in the old frontier who travels with a feathered pet and loots banks and garrisons. His family was slain by a gang, so he swore revenge and clashed again and again with a hired gun who sold him useless rifles.

feats.scene: Eruser fires a revolver and saber together in a single sweep through a saloon.
Eruser rolls from a galloping horse onto rock and remains in the saddle moments later.

reply.summary: Tirror is a mutated outlaw from a blended frontier world who rides with a band of misfits. Little is known beyond a stray mention in a fan letters column.

feats.scene: Tirror hurls a mutated claw into a saloon table and splits it in two.
Tirror eats a point-blank shotgun blast and sneers.

reply.summary: Tiuci is a smuggler with dreams of ruling who can take over minds, luring his countrymen onto a ship with false promises and then sending them against a hero. A wrestler's grip is his only other skill.

feats.scene: Tiuci slams a hostile sailor to the deck with a wrestling throw.
Tiuci is drenched in crude and clubbed on a pipeline, yet grins.

reply.summary: Rensiaau is a four-armed, purple-skinned peacekeeper with a tail who guards a stretch of space with a power ring. After a wound, he hands his ring to a fearless patient who proves more effective than he is.

feats.scene: Rensiaau fires a ring beam through an asteroid and splits it into glowing halves.
Rensiaau shields himself with a green barrier against a starship volley.

reply.summary: Retelseo is a four-armed, tailed peacekeeper who patrols a distant sector with a power ring and a charging lantern. His partner is a cheerful oddball whose bravery contrasts with his own grim seriousness.

feats.scene: Retelseo hurls a ring blast that shatters a derelict freighter into drifting slag.
Retelseo hovers inside a green field as a pirate cruiser opens fire.

reply.summary: Lasles is a white-haired radiant monarch who rules a paradise from a keep named after his son and is loved by his people. His strength is nearly limitless, but it fades if worshippers forget him, and he is missing a limb.

feats.scene: Lasles floods a sky with golden light that boils an ocean to steam.
Lasles holds firm at the centre of a collapsing sun-gate and shrugs off the blast.

reply.summary: Ialeorvor is an elder spirit that joined a council of ancient forces who lent their gifts to a mortal wizard. His own gift is the sharing of strength with others, and he counts courage as a weapon.

feats.scene: Ialeorvor pours stored force into a chosen mortal and a mountain lifts off its roots.
Ialeorvor remains whole as the plane around him folds in on itself.

reply.summary: Vaamo is a coastal dark-arts practitioner who has traded souls since decades past and was rewarded by hidden forces with a very long life. A single spoken word can freeze police in place, and he has killed children in ritual.

feats.scene: Vaamo speaks one word and a bus rolls on its side, spilling glass across the road.
Vaamo is struck by a thrown bottle and hardly flinches.

reply.summary: Ausam is the sea-born queen of a drowned kingdom in a grim future, strong, quick and tough beyond any surface person. She bends water to her will, flies by magic, and wields a great three-pronged spear.

feats.scene: Ausam raises a wall of surf and drives it through a coastal tower.
Ausam stays standing as a collapsing seawall slams down on her.

reply.summary: Sttiani is a white-haired elder from a family in which magical talent skips every other generation. Her imagination and moods reshape the dreamlike realm she rules, and she has passed her gifts to her son and grandson.

feats.scene: Sttiani imagines a storm and a whole valley of her dream realm tears itself apart.
Sttiani sits calm as her own nightmares swarm and break against her.

reply.summary: Carrere is a blond attorney in a big city who loves her half-brother and worries about his dangerous masked hobby. She leads the family in tracking him down when he goes missing.

feats.scene: Carrere slaps a briefcase against a mugger's arm and sends his knife skittering.
Carrere is shoved down courthouse steps and picks herself up.

reply.summary: Iumcotir is a girl who died young and was later conjured back as a living construct of coloured light by her grieving brother. She serves a corps that draws on hope and comforts a mother who has forgotten the loss.

feats.scene: Iumcotir shapes a glowing blue wall and slams it into a crumbling gate.
Iumcotir is struck by a falling beam and flickers back together.

reply.summary: Leoaulnt is a self-charging fighter from an old console game who claims to be the strongest on his world. He fires a killer beam from his arm and is beaten by a masked hero.

feats.scene: Leoaulnt aims his arm at a steel bulkhead and a blinding beam melts a hole through it.
Leoaulnt takes a thrown batarang to the chest and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Cosorrn is a blond thug who inherits the shock gloves of his dead boss and upgrades them under threat. He shocks a famous crimefighter a couple of times before taking a frozen blast to the mouth and a fatal visit from a rival.

feats.scene: Cosorrn jams both gloves against a metal railing and a crackling arc jumps the length of the rooftop.
Cosorrn spits blood after a punch to the face and keeps lunging.

reply.summary: Ntarium is a blond swordsman in a wired suit that lets him generate current through his hands, adjusting it to stun or to kill. He is sent as an envoy to strike a deal, walks into a trap, and bleeds out against a wall.

feats.scene: Ntarium sends a blue arc across a banquet table and blows every candle out.
Ntarium takes a duelist's cut across the shoulder and keeps his blade up.

reply.summary: Amoiu is a green-eyed killer from an ancient desert land who treats cats as her family and wears a headdress shaped from a sacred relic. She is a fine acrobat, thief and knife-thrower, and rumour credits her with several spare lives.

feats.scene: Amoiu throws a trio of knives that pin a guard's sleeve to a temple door.
Amoiu drops from a high ledge, lands light and sprints away.

reply.summary: Nianen is a common pooch who gained the power to rearrange the matter around and within him after exposure to a glowing relic. He can turn to vapour and float, and his teeth can chew through stone.

feats.scene: Nianen clamps his jaws on a boulder and crunches it into gravel.
Nianen turns to vapour as a hammer swings through him and re-forms wagging.

reply.summary: Titumoro is the head scientist of a secret military programme, inheriting an obsession from a grandfather who tried to open a gate to a realm of living energy. Brilliant and guarded, she works alongside a hero team.

feats.scene: Titumoro hurls a heavy clipboard at a trespasser and cracks his visor.
Titumoro is caught in a lab blast and walks out with singed sleeves.

reply.summary: Aulraser is a grey-skinned, bald bruiser with the bulk and strength of a tusked giant, fighting for a gang of villains. He once held a metal-limbed hero to a standstill until his gang was whisked away.

feats.scene: Aulraser stomps the floor of a warehouse and cracks the concrete from wall to wall.
Aulraser takes a heavy cannon blast square on the chest and barely rocks.
